definitionZh: 在弹性容器的弹性包装或弹性流动财产包括余额关键词的情况下,灵活组合项目的最低灵活组合项目数目将予以平衡。
sourceDefinition: The flex-line-count CSS property sets the minimum number of flex lines that flex items will be balanced over in cases where a flex container's flex-wrap or flex-flow property includes the balance keyword.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The flex-line-count CSS property sets the minimum number of flex lines that flex items will be balanced over in cases where a flex container's flex-wrap or flex-flow property includes the balance keyword.
